description: Create a longitudinal terrain profile in TopoCal. TopoCal is open with a pre-saved project containing 204 survey points and a Digital Terrain Model (DTM/MDT) already built from those points. The survey area covers the Colorado foothills with elevations from approximately 1718m to 2458m. Generate a terrain profile by using TopoCal's profile function. In TopoCal's Spanish menu interface: look for the 'Perfil' menu (profile) and select the option to create a longitudinal profile ('Perfil longitudinal' or similar). Draw a profile line across the terrain from west to east (left to right across the drawing area) by clicking two points on the drawing. The resulting profile window should display the elevation changes along the selected line.
